saw_lines: Golfers rarely buy gear on impulse. They ask if it fits their handicap, how it arrives and if returns are easy.
So a buyer who cannot see how the order arrives leaves before the price matters.
Your site explains how it arrives, yet 0 of 30 ads show it. Shoot one video of the box arriving at the golfer’s door and run it first.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 6 Nov 2026
points: Your site explains how it arrives, but 0 of 30 ads mention delivery, so a golfer weighing irons has no answer before buying. Shoot one short video of the box arriving at the door and lead with it.
0 of 30 ads are video, so a golfer scrolling your feed never sees a swing. Shoot three short videos of a club, a bag and a glove in use, and run them on Instagram and Facebook first.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so buyers have nothing to weigh against the price. Collect one real number, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.

19 of 30 ads are feed cards with no story, so a golfer scrolling Instagram gets a product grid and no reason to stop. Add three story ads, such as which set fits your handicap or what a fitting involves.

ads_1: Video and story ads on delivery, club fit and product in use
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Youtube
